records.name: Asher
records.distinguisher: eighth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:11, GEN 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid

records.name: Caesar Augustus
records.distinguisher: the Caesar whose decree that all the world should be taxed brought Joseph to Bethlehem (LUK 2:1-4)

records.name: David
records.distinguisher: son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3)

records.name: Holy Spirit
records.distinguisher: whom the text calls the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of God (MAT 28:19; 1CO 3:16)

records.name: Joseph
records.distinguisher: son of Jacob in the lineage of the Messiah (MAT 1:16)

records.name: Mary
records.distinguisher: wife of Joseph, and mother of the Messiah (MAT 1:16)

records.name: Moses
records.distinguisher: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (EXO 13:3)

records.name: Phanuel
records.distinguisher: the father of Anna the prophetess (LUK 2:36)

records.name: Quirinius
records.distinguisher: govern of Syria when the census at the time of Jesus' birth occurred (LUK 2:2)

records.name: Simeon
records.distinguisher: the righteous and devout man in Jerusalem looking for the consolation of Israel (LUK 2:25)

records.name: the angel of the LORD
records.distinguisher: definite article "the" angel (GEN 16:7, GEN 22:11, EXO 3:2, NUM 22:22, JDG 2:1, etc.)
